summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.34/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.34 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 25, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 23¢ lower than a week ago, $1.21 lower than a month ago, and 59¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.04) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.68).
